# Approved numerical summary
Use only the fixed dependency environment. No online installation or credential access.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
def run(payload):
    frame = pd.DataFrame({'value': payload['values']})
    frame.to_csv('analytics-result.csv', index=False)
    data = frame['value'].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    return {'mean': float(np.mean(data)), 'total': float(np.sum(data)), 'count': len(data)}
